page.overview:
Who is Dot Han?

He is a competitor in the Steel Ball Run race. He is later killed after being used by Sandman to attack the protagonists.

Dot Han is a muscular man, with a mostly shaved head and ponytail.

Little is known about Dot Han's personality though early in the race he appeared to be quite confident in his racing ability. Like most people, he was confused and horrified while under the effects of a Stand.

Originating from Far East, Dot Han is renowned for being an Equestrian master. He is the descendant of of the Mongol Nomads that conquered Eurasia.
